flagged_claims.reason: This figure represents a ~96% year-over-year increase compared to the reported Q2 2022 revenue ($2,388 million). Such growth is economically implausible for a mature consumer health segment (stable staples) during a divestiture period without major acquisitions. The figure may represent Year-to-Date revenue mislabeled as Q2, or a hallucination.

flagged_claims.reason: This figure is inconsistent with the known scale of the Johnson & Johnson Consumer Health business (later Kenvue), which reported approximately $15 billion in annual sales for 2022. This implies an average quarterly revenue of ~$3.75 billion, making $2.388 billion suspiciously low for a full quarter.
